```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
trap 'echo "Error in script at $BASH_SOURCE:$LINENO with exit code $?" >&2' ERR EXIT

SCRIPT_URL="https://example.com/script.sh"
LOCAL_SCRIPT="script.sh"
SHA256SUM_URL="https://example.com/script.sh.sha256"
LOCAL_SHA256SUM="script.sh.sha256"
EXPECTED_HASH="expected-sha256-hash"

# Download the script and its SHA256 checksum
echo "Downloading script..."
curl -sSL "$SCRIPT_URL" -o "$LOCAL_SCRIPT"
curl -sSL "$SHA256SUM_URL" -o "$LOCAL_SHA256SUM"

# Verify the downloaded script against the expected hash
ACTUAL_HASH=$(shasum -a 256 "$LOCAL_SCRIPT" | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$ACTUAL_HASH" != "$EXPECTED_HASH" ]; then
  echo "Error: Hash mismatch. Expected $EXPECTED_HASH but got $ACTUAL_HASH" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Execute the script
echo "Executing script..."
bash "$LOCAL_SCRIPT"
echo "Script executed successfully."
```
### Explanation
This script uses `set -euo pipefail` to ensure that errors in any command cause the script to exit immediately. It traps errors and exits to print the location and exit code of any failure.
